I also found it difficult to accept, but I had to if I was going to stay true to our beliefs.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|<ref name="Republic 62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Cerea''' was a month-long battle that took place on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] world of [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]. The paradise world was ravaged by [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] forces until defeated by the Republic. The battle ended when [[Bo-Ro-Tara]] was assassinated by [[Gossam Commandos/Legends|Gossam Commandos]]. It was also during the battle that the Cerean [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] lost [[Mundi family|his family]].
